questions.question: In 42, who does Harrison Ford play?
questions.note: The Brooklyn Dodgers executive who signs Robinson. Chadwick Boseman plays Jackie. 2013.

questions.question: In Cowboys & Aliens, what is Harrison Ford’s character named?
questions.note: Ford plays the hard-edged Colonel Dolarhyde opposite Daniel Craig.

questions.question: In Ender’s Game, what is Harrison Ford’s military instructor character named?
questions.note: Graff recruits and trains Ender Wiggin for humanity’s war against the Formics.

questions.question: In The Devil’s Own, what is Ford’s Tom O’Meara?
questions.note: He takes in a boarder. It goes badly at the dinner table.

questions.question: In The Devil’s Own, Ford’s cop takes in a lodger who is secretly what?
questions.note: The young Irishman is in New York to finish a job. O’Meara thought he was helping a kid.

questions.question: Who directed The Devil’s Own (1997)?
questions.note: Pakula’s last film. He had already made Presumed Innocent with Ford.

questions.question: In What Lies Beneath, what is Ford’s Norman Spencer hiding?
choices: That the house is not his
questions.note: His wife thinks the house is haunted. The ghost is the student.

questions.question: In Morning Glory, what is Harrison Ford’s grumpy television anchor named?
questions.note: Pomeroy is forced to co-anchor a struggling morning show with Diane Keaton.

questions.question: In The Age of Adaline, who does Harrison Ford play?
questions.note: Ford plays the father of the man Adaline falls for, and recognizes her from decades earlier.

questions.question: In Captain America: Brave New World, which MCU role does Harrison Ford take?
questions.note: President Thaddeus Ross. In the movie he hulks out as Red Hulk.
